गोद 3. गोद, अम् or अस्, n. m. the brain;
[cf. 1. गो-द, p. 297, and गोर्द.]

2. गोदान, अम्, n. the part of the head close to the
right ear: (for 1. गो-दान see under गो.)
—गोदान-
विधि, इस्, m. or गोदान-मङ्गल, अम्, n. a ceremony
performed by anointing that part of the head of a
youth of sixteen or eighteen years, when he has attained
the age of puberty, and shortly before marriage.
गोदावरी गो-दावरी. See under गो, p. 297.
